units: pixels (image coords, x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of the building facade vs median background: |shift| < 0.01 px in every frame)
camera.view: street scene seen roughly perpendicular to the street; facade/curb lines are horizontal in the image, so camera has ~no roll and little yaw; motion of both people is mostly parallel to the image x axis (right -> left)

depth_order_near_to_far: pink parked bicycle (near sidewalk/street edge, y~680)
cyclist (riding along the far curb, y~590-610)
walker (far sidewalk next to the houses, feet y~557)
perspective_cues.horizon: not visible (above the frame); building horizontals ~level => horizon row unknown, optical axis roughly horizontal

walker.description: adult man, white T-shirt, light-blue jeans, dark grey hair, white/grey face; walks right->left on the far sidewalk in front of the green house / stone house
walker.occluded_frames: 13-33 (cyclist passes in front of him; legs/torso hidden behind bicycle and rider)
walker.reference_point: pelvis estimate: x = median x of mask rows 20-45% of body height from top (torso), y = top + 0.47*height; frames 13-33: head_x + 1.95 px

apparent_height_px.note: head top (hair) to lowest shoe pixel; varies with gait (head bob, foot lift) +-2-3 px measurement noise; slow decrease => walker drifts slightly away from camera

cyclist.description: rider in dark navy jacket and light-blue jeans, dark hair, on a dark-blue city bicycle with rear rack; rides right->left along the far curb
cyclist.visible_frames: 2-98 (enters at right edge f2, fully inside f13-89, front wheel reaches left edge f90, still partly visible at f98)
cyclist.occlusion: in front of the walker f13-33 (cyclist bbox then includes walker pixels); behind the parked pink bicycle f73-98 (bike part hidden, rider upper body visible)
cyclist.reference_point: midpoint between the two wheel hubs (close to the bottom bracket / a bicycle root at mid-wheelbase); rider pelvis (saddle) is about (+40, -95) px * tm_scale from it

apparent_scale_vs_frame35.note: template-match scale; size shrinks ~12% over f13-79 and hub row rises 562->542 => cyclist moves away from the camera while riding left

pink_parked_bicycle.description: pastel-pink women's bicycle with tan saddle, tan fenders, front basket, parked on kickstand at lower left, facing left, in front of the telephone booth
pink_parked_bicycle.note: front wheel partly hidden behind the small iron fence at x 0-200; closest object to the camera; occludes the cyclist f73-98

telephone_booth.note: white/grey booth labelled TELEPHONE, posters, left of shop

events.event: walker already walking left (x~1685); cyclist not yet in view
cyclist front wheel enters at the right image edge
cyclist fully inside frame; begins to pass in front of the walker (image overlap f13-33)
cyclist reference x passes walker reference x (overtakes him in image x, between f21 and f22)
cyclist starts to pass behind the parked pink bicycle
cyclist front wheel reaches the left image edge (starts leaving)
clip ends; cyclist still partly visible at x 0-62; walker at x~1185 still walking

events.note: no stops, bounces, impacts or direction reversals: both people move steadily right->left the whole time
